$comment: Pack identity, separate from adapter support, so three states stay distinguishable: a known pack at a supported release (an adapter exists), a known pack at an unsupported release (UNRESOLVED — we have not established how to compose that release), and an unknown pack (a registry or manifest error). Collapsing the last two would let a typo in a project's standards.yml read as an unsupported version, and would let a genuinely unsupported release read as a nonexistent authority. Listing a pack here is identity only. It grants nothing, and it is deliberately NOT a disabled adapter placeholder: the absence of an adapter file is the evidence that no composition contract has been established for any of that pack's releases.
